annotations.title: Compress a video to an exact size

description: Compress a local video file to a target size (for example 20mb for Discord or WeChat, 16mb for WhatsApp, 18mb for email) and return the measured quality loss (VMAF/SSIM). Runs entirely on this machine: nothing is uploaded. Use it when a video will not fit through an upload limit.

dryRun.description: Only return the plan (bitrate, resolution, warnings) without encoding.

input.description: Path to the local video file.

output.description: Output path. Defaults to <input>.<target>.mp4 next to the input.

target.description: Target size, e.g. 20mb, 16mb, 800k, 1.5gb. No unit means MB.

verify.description: Measure VMAF/SSIM after encoding. Defaults to true; false is faster.

name: compress_video
title: Compress a video to an exact size
